edits.content:
## Auditing piecewise classifications and uniform bounds
- For near-identical piecewise formulas, audit branch conditions separately from branch expressions: verify exact endpoints, strict versus inclusive comparisons, coverage of the allowed domain, and how any overlaps are handled. Then check every expression and the stated “otherwise” case. A structural summary is not a complete classification when explicit terms are requested.
- For a strongest uniform estimate, preserve the full quantified domain and constant dependence. Compare the exact cutoff, logarithm argument, and prefactor; test boundary and asymptotic regimes rather than reducing choices to the same big-O rate. Do not silently replace a uniform constant by one depending on time.
